description.value: An 85-site campground on the shores of Buttle Lake inside Strathcona Park, BC's oldest provincial park and a vast mountain wilderness on Vancouver Island, with good trout fishing and access to alpine hiking; expect a summer season, cool evenings, and rain at any time.
